product_name.value: Tata AIA Life Insurance Smart Sampoorna Raksha
product_name.quote: Tata AIA Life Insurance Smart Sampoorna Raksha, Non-Participating, Unit Linked, Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan

irdai_description_line.value: Non-Participating, Unit Linked Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan
irdai_description_line.quote: Non-Participating, Unit Linked Individual Life Insurance Savings Plan

ppt_options.value: limited 5, 10 or 12 years; regular (equal to term)

premium_min_annual.value: Rs 60,000 (limited pay 5 years); Rs 18,000 (others); top-up Rs 5,000

sum_assured_rule.value: minimum 7x AP (age 49 and below) or 5x (50+); no maximum, subject to underwriting; top-up SA 1.25x (under 50) or 1.10x
sum_assured_rule.quote: For age 49 and below : 7 times of Annualised Premium

premium_modes.quote: Annual, Half yearly, Quarterly and Monthly

life_cover_multiple_choice.quote: Increase or decrease in Basic Sum Assured or TopUp Sum Assured is not allowed.

premium_allocation_charge.quote: Top-up Premium Allocation Charge shall be 2% of each Top-Up Premium.
premium_allocation_charge.note: base rates from the -layout table; guaranteed

policy_administration_charge.value: nil for years 1-4; from year 5: 0.41% of AP per month, rising 5% a year compound until year 18, cap Rs 500 a month
policy_administration_charge.quote: From 5th Policy Year onwards, Policy Administration Charge of 0.41% of Annualised Premium shall be charged at the beginning of each Policy Month.

fund_management_charge.quote: Whole Life Short-Term Fixed Income Fund

mortality_charge.value: SAR x monthly rate by attained age; guaranteed; rates not printed
mortality_charge.quote: The Mortality Charges will be guaranteed for the Policy Term.

discontinuance_charge.quote: The applicable discontinuance charges are as given

switching_charge.value: 12 free a year, then Rs 100 per switch
switching_charge.quote: There are 12 free switches per Policy Year.

premium_redirection_charge.quote: There is no Premium Re-direction charge.

guarantee_charge.quote: There is no investment guarantee under this plan.

any_charge_returned.value: 2x mortality charges monthly from year 11; 2x the year 1-4 allocation charges at the end of years 10-13
any_charge_returned.quote: At the end of 10th, 11th, 12th and 13th Policy Years, two (2) times the total Premium Allocation Charges (excluding taxes), deducted over the Policy Years 1, 2, 3 and 4 respectively

death_benefit_formula.value: highest of SA less PW in last 2 years, fund value, 105% of premiums; plus higher of top-up SA or top-up fund
death_benefit_formula.quote: 105% of the Total premiums paid up to the date of death net of all “Deductible Partial Withdrawals”, if any.

maturity_benefit.value: fund value plus top-up fund value
maturity_benefit.quote: If the Insured is alive on the Maturity Date, Fund Value (as applicable) and Top Up Premium Fund Value

loyalty_additions.value: refund of charges and a cover continuance booster (see the fields below)
loyalty_additions.quote: Provided the Policy is in force and all due premiums have been paid, following units shall be added till death or maturity, whichever is earlier.

wealth_boosters_or_guaranteed_additions.value: Cover Continuance Booster: tops up the fund if it falls below 10% of the modal premium (years 1-15) or below the fund implied by a target net yield (year 16 on); the target uses a reduction in yield of 4.25% at the maximum SA multiple and a table value (3.10% for PPT 5) at 10x
wealth_boosters_or_guaranteed_additions.quote: Cover Continuance Booster – Non-negative amounts called Cover Continuance Boosters

return_of_mortality_charges.value: 2x, monthly from year 11, of the charge 120 months earlier
return_of_mortality_charges.quote: Starting from the 11th Policy Year, two (2) times the monthly mortality charge

return_of_premium_allocation_charges.value: 2x the year 1-4 charges at the end of years 10-13
return_of_premium_allocation_charges.quote: At the end of 10th, 11th, 12th and 13th Policy Years, two (2) times the total Premium Allocation Charges (excluding taxes), deducted over the Policy Years 1, 2, 3 and 4 respectively

fund_switching.quote: There are 12 free switches per Policy Year.

premium_redirection.quote: No Premium Re-direction Charge is payable.

partial_withdrawals.value: after 5 policy anniversaries; minimum Rs 5,000; fund must stay above 1x AP; up to 4 a year
partial_withdrawals.quote: Partial Withdrawal is allowed maximum up to 4 times in a Policy year.

top_up_premiums.value: not in the last 5 years; minimum Rs 5,000; SA 1.25x (under 50) or 1.10x
top_up_premiums.quote: Each Top-Up Premium shall not be less than Rupees Five Thousand (Rs. 5,000).

increase_decrease_cover.quote: Increase or decrease in Basic Sum Assured or TopUp Sum Assured is not allowed.

policy_loan.quote: No loan is available from the Company under this Policy.
